relevance.reason: Discusses practical challenges of AI adoption in workplace and how teams need structure to learn AI effectively

title: How to implement AI training for employees
author: Jessica Lau
content_snippet: Most teams don't struggle to implement AI in their daily workflows because they're resistant to change—they struggle because they haven't been given the structure to learn how to use it effectively. Employees who receive formal AI training are far more likely to see it as a boost to their productivity and efficiency.
